arxiv-1401-3747.title: Low-Mass X-ray Binaries and Globular Clusters Streamers and Arcs in NGC4278. Note: version August 8, 2026: fm
arxiv-1401-3747.creator: R. D’Abrusco, G. Fabbiano & N.J. Brassington
arxiv-1401-3747.description: A 2014 arXiv research paper by R. D’Abrusco, G. Fabbiano & N.J. Brassington. We report significant inhomogeneities in the projected two-dimensional (2D) spatial distributions of Low-Mass X-ray Binaries (LMXBs) and Globular Clusters (GCs) of the intermediate mass elliptical galaxy NGC4278. In the inner region of NGC4278, a significant arc-like excess of LMXBs extending south of the center at ∼ 50 ′′ \sim 50^{\prime\prime} in the western side of the galaxy can be associated to a similar over-density of the spatial distribution of red GCs from Brassington et al.

arxiv-2203-15875.title: Electrosorption-induced deformation of a porous electrode with non-convex pore geometry in electrolyte solutions: a theoretical study
arxiv-2203-15875.creator: Andrei L. Kolesnikov, Daria A. Mazur, Yury A. Budkov
arxiv-2203-15875.description: Abstract Porous carbon is well known as a good candidate for the development of electrochemical double-layer capacitors. Predominantly, many conventional carbons are microporous and often well described by the assumption of slit pore geometry. However, there is a class of carbons that is significantly different from the others, namely templated mesoporous carbons.

Corresponding authors: Adrian Höhl, Ivica Obadic, and Xiao Xiang Zhu. Thanks: Adrian Höhl is with the Chair of Data Science in Earth Observation, Technical
arxiv-2402-13791.creator: Adrian Höhl, Ivica Obadic, Miguel-Ángel Fernández-Torres, Hiba NajjarDario Oliveira, Zeynep Akata, Andreas Dengel and Xiao Xiang Zhu
arxiv-2402-13791.description: Abstract In recent years, black-box machine learning approaches have become a dominant modeling paradigm for knowledge extraction in remote sensing. Despite the potential benefits of uncovering the inner workings of these models with explainable AI, a comprehensive overview summarizing the explainable AI methods used and their objectives, findings, and challenges in remote sensing applications is still missing.

arxiv-2406-15252.title: VideoScore : Building Automatic Metrics to Simulate Fine-grained Human Feedback for Video Generation
arxiv-2406-15252.description: Abstract The recent years have witnessed great advances in video generation. However, the development of automatic video metrics is lagging significantly behind. None of the existing metrics are able to provide reliable scores over generated videos. The main barrier is the lack of large-scale human-annotated datasets.

arxiv-2505-06409.title: Engineering Risk-Aware, Security-by-Design Frameworks for Assurance of Large-Scale Autonomous AI Models
arxiv-2505-06409.creator: Krti Tallam
arxiv-2505-06409.description: Abstract As AI models scale to billions of parameters and operate with increasing autonomy, ensuring their safe, reliable operation demands engineering-grade security and assurance frameworks. This paper presents an enterprise-level, risk-aware, security-by-design approach for large-scale autonomous AI systems, integrating standardized threat metrics, adversarial hardening techniques, and real-time anomaly detection into every phase of the development lifecycle.

pmc-11711360.creator: Remi Jacob, Sangeerthana A, Nadha Abdul Razack, Samudyata C Prabhuswamimath
pmc-11711360.description: Malignant ascites, a buildup of fluid in the abdominal cavity, is a serious consequence of many malignancies. pmc-12684920.creator: Kristian B. Kiradjiev, Jayne Griffiths, Alexander M. Jones, Leah R. Band
pmc-12684920.description: SignificanceMany aspects of animal and plant development are controlled by the spatial distribution of small molecules, termed hormones. pmc-13167251.title: A Membrane‐Centric Plasma Lipidomic Signature of Response to Long‐Acting Naltrexone in Alcohol Use Disorder
pmc-13167251.creator: Liyao Huang, Bojie Zhou, Qinling Ou, Jubo Yin, Xiwen Tian, Xuhui Zhou
pmc-13167251.description: Long‐acting naltrexone is a first‐line pharmacotherapy for alcohol use disorder (AUD), but clinical response is heterogeneous and the underlying biology remains incompletely understood. In a randomised, double‐blind, placebo‐controlled trial of naltrexone implants (n = 70), the prespecified primary endpoint—percentage of heavy‐drinking days (PHDD) over 24 weeks—favoured naltrexone (median 1.49% vs. 13.39%; p = 0.042).

pmc-13386861.creator: Qi Yu, Anna F Bekebrede, Natasja N G Costermans, Nicoline M Soede, Katja J Teerds, Jaap Keijer
pmc-13386861.description: BackgroundMammalian reproductive outcomes are influenced by whole-body energy status, especially in high-prolific sows. During lactation, high energy demands often lead to a severe negative energy balance (NEB), which compromises subsequent reproductive performance. The molecular processes underlying the sustained impact of lactational energy insufficiency on post-weaning follicular development are not well understood.

pmc-13511030.title: Significance of Cardiac Troponin in Cancer Patients
pmc-13511030.creator: Kristóf Birgés, Béla Merkely, Andrea Ágnes Molnár
pmc-13511030.description: Recent advances in oncological therapies have significantly improved cancer survival rates. Cardiac troponin, which is well-known for its role in diagnosing myocardial damage, is gaining recognition as a biomarker in the field of cardio-oncology.

pmc-13548793.description: IntroductionHospital‐at‐Home (HaH) has been implemented in several countries. However, HaH interventions vary depending on organisational structures and target populations. Currently, there are no guidelines or systematic overviews of Scandinavian HaH models.
